CustomField.description: Displays the Most Recent Won Opportunity field, unless the Pro Account Cancelled Date is more recent, then returns blank.
CustomField.formula: IF( OR( ISBLANK(Pro_Account_Cancelled_Date__c), Most_Recent_Won_Opportunity_Date__c > Pro_Account_Cancelled_Date__c ), Most_Recent_Won_Opportunity_Date__c, NULL )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The date of the account's most recent Closed Won opportunity (excluding upsells). This field clears if the Pro Account Cancelled Date is more recent.
CustomField.label: Most Recent Win Date
